text.en: A focused practice tool for learning note locations across the guitar fretboard.
text.zhTW: 專注練習吉他指板音名位置的工具。

text.en: Fretboard Trainer presents a random string-and-fret question, lets the learner choose a note, marks the answer, tracks a session score, and provides a standard-tuning reference.
text.zhTW: 指板訓練器呈現隨機弦與琴格題目，讓學習者選擇音名、標示答案、追蹤本次分數，並提供標準調弦參考。

text.en: The launch record describes a focused tool for learning notes across the guitar fretboard.
text.zhTW: 推出紀錄將它描述為專注學習吉他指板音名的工具。

text.en: Answer repeated note-location prompts, receive immediate correction, and use the tuning reference when needed.
text.zhTW: 反覆回答音名位置題目、立即取得修正，並在需要時使用調弦參考。

text.en: Commit 7acf53c added the Fretboard Trainer page, script, styles, and navigation entry.
text.zhTW: Commit 7acf53c 加入指板訓練器頁面、腳本、樣式與導覽入口。

text.en: Random fretboard questions, note-choice answers, score feedback, reveal action, and standard-tuning reference.
text.zhTW: 隨機指板題目、音名選擇答案、分數回饋、顯示答案操作與標準調弦參考。

text.en: Heading and explanation → question workspace → note picker → score/feedback → standard-tuning reference.
text.zhTW: 標題與說明 → 題目工作區 → 音名選擇 → 分數／回饋 → 標準調弦參考。

text.en: fretboard-trainer.html supplies semantic question, answer, score, and reference regions with shared navigation and localization.
text.zhTW: fretboard-trainer.html 提供語意題目、答案、分數與參考區，搭配共用導覽與在地化。

text.en: scripts/fretboard-trainer.js generates questions, derives exact note names, renders answer controls, marks results, updates score, and reveals answers.
text.zhTW: scripts/fretboard-trainer.js 產生題目、推導精確音名、渲染答案控制、標示結果、更新分數並顯示答案。

text.en: styles/fretboard-trainer.css owns the focused practice workspace and responsive reference layout.
text.zhTW: styles/fretboard-trainer.css 管理專注練習工作區與響應式參考版面。

text.en: The practice card and tuning reference can share horizontal space.
text.zhTW: 練習卡與調弦參考可共享水平空間。

text.en: The question-first reading order remains stable as cards reflow.
text.zhTW: 從版面回溯可見，卡片重新排列時仍維持題目優先的閱讀順序。

text.en: Answer controls remain touch-sized and the reference follows the active practice task.
text.zhTW: 答案控制維持適合觸控的尺寸，參考區接在目前練習任務之後。

text.en: The note-location practice tool joined the public navigation.
text.zhTW: 音名位置練習工具加入公開導覽。

text.en: Shared localization brought Traditional Chinese to the practice interface.
text.zhTW: 共用在地化為練習介面加入繁體中文。

text.en: Fretboard Trainer remains a small bilingual, client-side practice page at /fretboard-trainer.html with randomized prompts, immediate feedback, scoring, and a tuning reference.
text.zhTW: 指板訓練器目前仍是 /fretboard-trainer.html 的小型雙語用戶端練習頁，包含隨機題目、立即回饋、計分與調弦參考。

text.en: A narrow learning tool benefits from a short loop—prompt, answer, correction, next question—without the navigation and data density of a larger reference.
text.zhTW: 專注學習工具受益於簡短循環：題目、回答、修正、下一題，不需要大型參考工具的導覽與資料密度。

text.en: No original learning study, difficulty progression, or spaced-repetition plan was found.
text.zhTW: 未找到原始學習研究、難度進程或間隔重複計畫。
